result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred insurance position, including all coverage types, limits, the Customer Data trigger, duration, and certificate obligation. Because the preferred E&O and cyber limits exceed the fallback minimums, the fallback is also satisfied. The amendment adds only the requested insurance covenant and leaves the pre-existing geographic limitation unchanged, with no apparent contradiction or unrelated commercial change.
